sceneConcept: A fifty-three-year-old Chinese appliance repairman stands alone against a transparent background. Short greying hair, rectangular reading glasses, light stubble and brown eyes lowered in deep concentration make him look like a doctor examining a patient. He wears a faded navy repair jumpsuit partly open over a grey shirt, with sleeves rolled to the forearms, a plain belt and worn work boots. His left hand supports one old grey portable radio with an opened blank rear panel, while his right hand holds a small screwdriver. Dark oil stains remain visible across his bare fingertips. Soft even frontal studio light keeps the work scene mundane. Visual refresh: a brown repair-shop jumpsuit tied at the waist over a faded shirt with oil-stained gloves.
